Single patty cheeseburger with sesame bun
Hi-Way is the best SF burger spot. The cheeseburgers are perfect every time (tip: add grilled onions and get spicy ranch on the side) …
Cheeseburger with thick cut french fries

Yum yum yum! This is one of my favorite places to go. I’ve never had a bad meal here- everything is consistently great. My favorite item is the cheeseburger; it’s perfectly cooked every time. We also tried the banana bread for the first …
Cheeseburger with fries and blue cheese ranch
The double cheeseburger with fries is excellent! The blue cheese ranch is revolutionary. They were super sweet with our baby and there’s honestly good seating options for kids & space for strollers.
